suppress.notes: Spring 3.2.18 is end-of-life and has multiple CVEs. Cannot upgrade to Spring 4+ without rewriting XML configuration to Java config and updating Hibernate integration. Requires coordination with mainframe team.
Hibernate 3.6.10 has known vulnerabilities but upgrade blocked. PaymentProcessor uses deprecated HQL queries that don't work in Hibernate 4+. Tracked in technical debt backlog.
MySQL Connector 5.1.6 is ancient but moving to newer version requires testing all database operations and may have compatibility issues with MySQL 5.5 production database.
Log4j 1.2.16 is end-of-life (Log4Shell not applicable to 1.x but other CVEs exist). Migration to Log4j2 planned for Q2. Requires updating all logging configuration and testing across all modules.
Various Apache Commons libraries are outdated. Low priority for upgrade - no known exploitation in our environment.
org.json:json version 20090211 is very old. Used only in REST API. Migration to Jackson planned with Spring upgrade.
